data.title: Make a Website Look More Polished
data.outcome: Spot the specific reasons a page feels unpolished and improve it with hierarchy, rhythm, consistency, and feedback.
intentExamples: Make my website look more polished

stages.title: Turn “polished” into a clear visual direction
stages.action: Choose references that fit the product and state what to keep and avoid.
stages.evidence: You can describe the visual direction with specific traits instead of just saying it looks good.

lessons.title: Minimalism
lessons.tagline: Remove what does not help the task and make the remaining hierarchy clear

lessons.title: Apple HIG
lessons.tagline: Use precise hierarchy, generous space, and polished product imagery

lessons.title: SaaS Marketing Site
lessons.tagline: Place the value, product proof, and next action on one clear reading path

stages.title: Make important content stand out first
stages.action: Adjust the hierarchy of headings, body copy, supporting information, and the primary button.
stages.evidence: Users can quickly identify the page focus and next step.

lessons.title: Typography
lessons.tagline: Use text size and style to show what matters first

lessons.title: Opacity
lessons.tagline: Make an element and its contents more transparent

lessons.title: Space
lessons.tagline: Use empty space to show which things belong together

stages.title: Create a steady rhythm with spacing and layout
stages.action: Standardize section gaps, card padding, and alignment.
stages.evidence: Peer elements have a consistent rhythm, and related content sits closer together.

lessons.title: Margin
lessons.tagline: Create space outside an element

lessons.title: Padding
lessons.tagline: Create space between a box and its content

lessons.title: Grid
lessons.tagline: Plan rows and columns as one layout system

lessons.title: Flex
lessons.tagline: Arrange items along one row or one column

stages.title: Unify corners, borders, and shadows
stages.action: Use a consistent surface treatment for cards, buttons, and inputs.
stages.evidence: Components look like they belong to the same system.

lessons.title: Border Radius
lessons.tagline: Round the corners of a box

lessons.title: Shadow
lessons.tagline: Use light and depth to separate overlapping surfaces

lessons.title: Corner Feel
lessons.tagline: Use corner shape to support the product's visual tone

stages.title: Use subtle feedback to explain interaction
stages.action: Add feedback for pointer, keyboard focus, presses, and state changes.
stages.evidence: Feedback is clear without stealing attention from the content.

lessons.title: Hover
lessons.tagline: Respond when a pointer rests over an interactive element

lessons.title: Focus
lessons.tagline: Show which element will receive keyboard input

lessons.title: Active
lessons.tagline: Show that a control is being pressed right now

lessons.title: Transition
lessons.tagline: Smooth the change between two visual states

stages.title: Remove noise and compare before and after
stages.action: Remove decorative effects and animation that add no information.
stages.evidence: The hierarchy is clearer after the change without losing necessary feedback.

lessons.title: Gradient
lessons.tagline: Blend colors gradually across an area

lessons.title: Animation
lessons.tagline: Run a planned sequence of visual changes

lessons.title: Backdrop Blur
lessons.tagline: Blur the content behind a translucent surface
